topic: Classification of plants: angiosperms and gymnosperms
key_concepts: Plants can be grouped as flowering and non-flowering plants
Angiosperms have enclosed seeds produced from flowers
Gymnosperms have naked seeds produced from non-flowering plants
Angiosperms typically have flat and broad leaves
Gymnosperms often have scale-like or needle-like leaves
Mango trees are examples of angiosperms
Pine trees are examples of gymnosperms
A table can be used to classify plants into angiosperms and gymnosperms
Plants have general characteristics such as roots, stems, leaves, and photosynthesis
